The rand_r stream is consumed in exactly the same order as\n// the original sequential code so the generated graph is identical.\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& local, const size_t numNodes,\n                              const size_t N, const size_t row0, const size_t nLocalRows,\n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    const size_t rowEnd = std::min(row0 + nLocalRows, numNodes);\n    for (size_t i = 0; j < N; ++j) rowPtr[j] = INF;\n        }\n        rowPtr[i] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// The original double loop assigns path[j][i] = j and path[i][j] = i for all\n// (i,j), i.e. the final value of every entry (r,c) is its row index r.\nvoid initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& local, const size_t N,\n                          const size_t row0, const size_t nLocalRows) {\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0;            // padded node count\n    int nBlocks = 0;         // N / B\n    int firstBlock = 0;      // first tile-row owned by this rank\n    int nLocalBlocks = 0;    // number of tile-rows owned by this rank\n    std::vector<int> owner;  // owner rank of every tile-row\n};\n\nPartition makePartition(const size_t numNodes, const int rank, const int size) {\n    Partition p;\n    p.nBlocks = static_cast<int>((numNodes + B - 1) / B);\n    p.N = static_cast<size_t>(p.nBlocks) * B;\n    p.owner.resize(p.nBlocks);\n    for (int r = 0; On return the locally owned\n// rows of dist/path are up to date in device memory.\nvoid floydWarshall(unsigned int* d_dist, unsigned int* d_path, unsigned int* d_Rs,\n                   unsigned int* d_Dcol, unsigned int* d_Cs, unsigned int* h_Rs,\n                   const Partition& part, const int rank, const int size) {\n    const size_t N = part.N;\n    const dim3 threads(T, T);\n    const size_t rsBytes = static_cast<size_t>(B) * N * sizeof(unsigned int);\n\n    for (int K = 0; K < part.nBlocks; ++K) {\n        const int owner = part.owner[K];\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const size_t localRow0 = static_cast<size_t>(K - part.firstBlock) * B;\n            phase1Kernel<<<1, threads>>>(d_dist, d_path, N, K, localRow0, d_Rs, d_Dcol);\n            if (part.nBlocks > 1) {\n                phase2RowKernel<<<part.nBlocks - 1, threads>>>(d_dist, d_path, N, K, localRow0,\n                                                               d_Rs, d_Dcol);\n            }\n            if (size > 1) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_Rs, d_Rs, rsBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        if (size > 1) {\n            MPI_Bcast(h_Rs, static_cast<int>(B * N), MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            if (rank != owner) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_Rs, h_Rs, rsBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        }\n\n        if (part.nLocalBlocks > 0) {\n            phase2ColKernel<<<part.nLocalBlocks, threads>>>(d_dist, d_path, N, K, part.firstBlock,\n                                                            d_Rs, d_Cs);\n            if (part.nBlocks > 1) {\n                const dim3 grid(part.nBlocks - 1, part.nLocalBlocks);\n                phase3Kernel<<<grid, threads>>>(d_dist, d_path, N, K, part.firstBlock, d_Rs, d_Cs);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    {\n        bool ok = true;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(&& : ok)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) ok = false;\n        }\n        if (!ok) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n                if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n                    printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n                    return false;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    const size_t sample = std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10));\n    bool ok = true;\n#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) schedule(static) reduction(&& : ok)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < sample; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < sample; ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) ok = false;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    if (!ok) {\n        // Report the first violation in the original scan order\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < sample; ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < sample; ++j) {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                    const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                    const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                    const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                    if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                        if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                            printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\",\n                                   i, j, k);\n                            return false;\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n 0 : 1);\n    bool phase1Done = false;\n    int produced = 0;\n\n    auto tryProduce = [&]() {\n        while (produced < nChunks) {\n            const int c = chunkInOrder(P, produced);\n            if (!phase1Done || !rowReady[c]) break;\n            phase2RowKernel<<<chunkTiles(c), threads, 0, sPivot>>>(\n                dDist, dPath, N, P, localRow0, chunkStart[c], out.dRs, dDcol);\n            if (size > 1) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(out.hRs + chunkOffset(c), out.dRs + chunkOffset(c),\n                                           chunkElems(c) * sizeof(unsigned int),\n                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sPivot));\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(out.evChunk[c], sPivot));\n            ++produced;\n        }\n    };\n\n    if (lookahead) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < nChunks; ++i) {\n            const int c = chunkInOrder(Kprev, i);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sPivot, in.evChunk[c], 0));\n            const dim3 grid(chunkTiles(c), 1);\n            phase3Kernel<<<grid, threads, 0, sPivot>>>(\n                dDist, dPath, N, Kprev, part.firstBlock, P - part.firstBlock, Kprev, -1,\n                chunkStart[c], in.dRs, dCs);\n            rowReady[c] = 1;\n            if (c == cP) {\n                phase1Kernel<<<1, threads, 0, sPivot>>>(dDist, dPath, N, P, localRow0, out.dRs,\n                                                        dDcol);\n                phase1Done = true;\n            }\n            tryProduce();\n        }\n    } else {\n        phase1Kernel<<<1, threads, 0, sPivot>>>(dDist, dPath, N, P, localRow0, out.dRs, dDcol);\n        phase1Done = true;\n        tryProduce();\n    }\n}\n\n// Distribute the staged panel of block P from its owner to every rank, chunk\n// by chunk through a binomial tree.  Receivers forward each chunk to their\n// children and upload it to the device on the pivot stream.\nvoid Solver::communicate(const int P) {\n    if (size <= 1) return;\n    PanelBuf& buf = panel[P & 1];\n    const int root = part.owner[P];\n    const Tree tree = makeTree(root, rank, size);\n    const int tagBase = (P & 1) * nChunks;\n\n    if (rank == root) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < nChunks; ++i) {\n            const int c = chunkInOrder(P, i);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(buf.evChunk[c]));   // chunk is in hRs\n            for (const int child : tree.children) {\n                buf.sendReq.emplace_back();\n                MPI_Isend(buf.hRs + chunkOffset(c), static_cast<int>(chunkElems(c)), MPI_UNSIGNED,\n                          child, tagBase + c, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &buf.sendReq.back());\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // The previous upload from hRs (panel P-2) must have finished before the\n        // buffer is overwritten by incoming data.\n        for (const cudaEvent_t ev : buf.evChunk) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(ev));\n        buf.recvReq.resize(nChunks);\n        for (int c = 0; c < nChunks; ++c) {\n            MPI_Irecv(buf.hRs + chunkOffset(c), static_cast<int>(chunkElems(c)), MPI_UNSIGNED,\n                      tree.parent, tagBase + c, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &buf.recvReq[c]);\n        }\n        for (int i = 0; PanelBuf& out = panel[next & 1];\n        if (!out.sendReq.empty()) {\n            MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(out.sendReq.size()), out.sendReq.data(),\n                        MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n            out.sendReq.clear();\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sPivot, evCol, 0));\n        if (ownNext) issueProduction(next, true);\n Every finished chunk is\n// copied to the host staging slot (if needed) and its event recorded.\nvoid Solver::issueProduction(const int P, const bool lookahead) {\n    const size_t N = part.N;\n    const dim3 threads(T, T);\n    const int slot = slotOf(P);\n    const int Kprev = P - 1;\n    const int inSlot = slotOf((P + NBUF - 1) % NBUF);\n    unsigned int* out = dRs[slot];\n    const unsigned int* in = dRs[inSlot];\n    unsigned int* hOut = hostSlot(rank, P);\n    const size_t localRow0 = static_cast<size_t>(P - part.firstBlock) * B;\n    const int localRow = P - part.firstBlock;\n    const int cP = chunkOf(P);\n\n    waitSlotFree(slot); The random graph generation itself stays sequential because `rand_r` must be consumed in the original order.\n\n**Things worth knowing.**\n- The single-GPU kernel runs near the INT32 throughput limit of the RTX 3090. I tested FP32 arithmetic, tile-wide write skipping, and per-element conditional stores. None helped, so they are not in the code.\n- This machine's Open MPI is not CUDA-aware, and its `MPI_Bcast` was pathologically slow with 4 ranks. That drove the shared-memory window design, which also removes all host-to-host copies.\n- Timed region includes copying the results back to host memory, so it is slightly stricter than the original's timing.\n- `CMakeLists.txt` now requires CMake 3.24 for `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=native`; set that variable explicitly when cross-compiling for a cluster with different GPUs.\n- Build directory was removed after testing. The random graph generation itself stays sequential because `rand_r` must be consumed in the original order.\n\n**Things worth knowing.**\n- The single-GPU kernel runs near the INT32 throughput limit of the RTX 3090. I tested FP32 arithmetic, tile-wide write skipping, and per-element conditional stores. None helped, so they are not in the code.\n- This machine's Open MPI is not CUDA-aware, and its `MPI_Bcast` was pathologically slow with 4 ranks. That drove the shared-memory window design, which also removes all host-to-host copies.\n- Timed region includes copying the results back to host memory, so it is slightly stricter than the original's timing.\n- `CMakeLists.txt` now requires CMake 3.24 for `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=native`; set that variable explicitly when cross-compiling for a cluster with different GPUs.\n- Build directory was removed after testing.
